description: Founded in 1918, The Yoga Institute in Mumbai is the world’s oldest yoga center, a sanctuary of wisdom and tranquility. Under the guidance of Dr. Hansaji Yogendra, our serene campus offers a spiritual haven for deepening your yoga practice. In 1954, we pioneered the world’s first Yoga Teacher Training Course (YTTC), which remains one of the most renowned and respected programs globally. We offer daily yoga classes, guided meditation, and specialized programs for stress relief, therapy, and prenatal yoga. Our free evening meditation sessions provide a peaceful retreat for all. Join us in Mumbai or online to experience the true essence of yoga.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the opportunity to visit The Yoga Institute, Santacruz in june 2024 along with my college mates as part of a college visit. It was truly a beautiful experience. The campus is extremely clean, calm, and peaceful — the kind of environment that instantly makes you feel relaxed and centered.

The atmosphere there reflects authenticity and simplicity. Everything is well-maintained, and the overall vibe is very grounding and serene.

We were also fortunate to meet Dr. Hansa Yogendra, the Director of The Yoga Institute. She is such a down-to-earth and humble person. Despite her immense knowledge and experience, she interacts with warmth and simplicity, which left a very positive impression on us.

It was a memorable visit, and I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants to experience traditional yoga in a peaceful setting.

featured_reviews.name: Divya Choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text:

I would highly recommend this institute to anyone seeking personal growth, inner peace, and a deeper understanding of yoga. It is truly a life-changing experience.

featured_reviews.name: Nisha Vyas
featured_reviews.review_text:
Namaste 🙏

I have completed my 900-hours ATTC and Yoga Therapy Course from The Yoga Institute and it has truly brought a deep transformation in my life. The course helped me grow physically, mentally, emotionally and spiritually while giving me authentic knowledge and confidence in teaching yoga.
Learning Yoga Therapy under  Dr. Taruna was an excellent experience. Her teaching was very clear, practical, and inspiring.
I feel grateful that I can now use this knowledge to bring positive transformation in others’ lives as well. Heartfelt gratitude to all the teachers and staff for their constant guidance and support. 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Devika Cheulkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Yoga Institute is not just a place to learn yoga it is a place where yoga is lived. Rooted deeply in tradition, this institute offers an authentic and classical understanding of yoga that goes far beyond physical practice. It’s aligned with true Indian philosophy, preserving the true essence of yoga in a world where it is often diluted.

On a practical level, the training is structured, disciplined, and thorough. From asana alignment and anatomy to pranayama, meditation, philosophy, and teaching methodology, every subject is taught with clarity and precision. The faculty is knowledgeable, experienced, and genuinely invested in shaping confident, responsible yoga teachers.

Emotionally, this journey has been deeply transformative. Yoga here is not treated as a fitness trend, but as a way of life, both on and off the mat.  I would wholeheartedly recommend this institute to anyone seeking authentic yoga knowledge and meaningful personal growth.

featured_reviews.name: 3514 Hetvi Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been associated with the institute since past 1 year and it has helped me heal mentally,  physically and emotionally.  The kitchen and food served here is awesome and like home only but sattvik. The institute has a very beautiful library and faculty too.

featured_reviews.name: kamaljit Singh Sandhu
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 Stars: Transformative Year at The Yoga Institute.
My one-year Advanced Teacher Training Course at The Yoga Institute has been nothing short of life-changing.
I joined seeking a deeper understanding of the synchronization between the Law of the Universe, the laws governing our mind, body, and consciousness, and how they interplay with modern society's laws.
I discovered a beautiful, harmonious relationship among all three.
The comprehensive syllabus—spanning Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, Hatha Yoga, Bhagavad Gita, and Samkhya philosophy—brought this to life.
The teachers are true yogis, with Dr. Hansa ji, one of the greatest yoginis, sharing profound wisdom from ancient yogic sciences through her masterful guidance on sutra applications, pranayama techniques, and holistic living. Asana practice revealed the psychosomatic truth: "as the mind, so the body; as the body, so the mind," synchronizing my entire being.
Now, yoga is my way of life.Unparalleled for authentic self-discovery. Grateful beyond words!.... Namaskar 🙏
Kamaljit Singh Sandhu.

featured_reviews.review_text: The moment you enter inside The Yoga Institute there is a positive vibe all around, variety of tress, plants, herbs, the environment is positive and it lifts your energy, also Maa Hanshaji santsang insights are very helpful in day to day life, the satvic food is also good, all the faculty members are supportive in every aspect may be it curriculum or life related. I would like to thank to Yogendra family for life changing experience Namaste🙏.

featured_reviews.name: Purnendu Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
In early 2026, during a small thanksgiving gathering with office colleagues, I took a moment to acknowledge my journey and express gratitude to a few people who made 2025 particularly meaningful for me. Among them, I especially mentioned Dr. Nikita Chavan for her consistent care and support throughout my recovery.
On 11th September 2024, I began my first day at Evolution of Movement (EOM), Colaba, about 45 days after a herniated slip disc injury at the L5-S1 region. The recovery initially felt slow and uncertain, but gradually I understood that healing is not immediate—it is a step-by-step process that requires patience, consistency, and trust.
A close family friend had recommended EOM and Dr. Chavan, describing her as skilled, attentive, and confident in her approach. I decided to visit, and she warmly received me for consultation.
That first morning, walking to the centre felt like a quiet step toward recovery. The environment at EOM was calm and reassuring—very different from a conventional clinical setup.
When I met Dr. Chavan, she reviewed my reports and examined the injury with calm clarity. She assured me that full recovery was possible, though it would take time and disciplined effort.
The initial sessions were not easy. Even simple movements felt difficult due to stiffness and a lack of confidence after the injury. But her approach was always steady, realistic, and compassionate, which made a significant difference.
Over time, I began to trust both the process and the guidance. It became a journey of slowly rebuilding strength, awareness, and confidence.
Today, looking back, it has been almost two years under her care at EOM, starting from that initial injury. The journey has been steady and well-supported.
Currently, I am focusing on overall strength building across the body to maintain long-term fitness and stability.
Heartfelt thanks to Dr. Nikita Chavan and the EOM for  my recovery journey after my injury and helping me regain strength and confidence.
